# Data Model: Contact Lens Reminder

**Generated by**: /speckit.plan (Phase 1)
**Date**: 2026-05-04

---

## Entities

### LensCycle

The single entity representing the user's active lens replacement cycle. Stored as a singleton row (`id = 1`) in the Room database.

| Field | Type | Stored As | Description |
|-------|------|-----------|-------------|
| `id` | `Int` | INTEGER (PK) | Always 1 — singleton pattern |
| `startDate` | `LocalDate` | TEXT (ISO-8601, e.g. `"2026-05-01"`) | The date the user put on the current pair |
| `interval` | `ReminderInterval` | TEXT (enum name) | Replacement schedule |
| `reminderHour` | `Int` | INTEGER | Hour of day for daily notification (0–23) |
| `reminderMinute` | `Int` | INTEGER | Minute of day for daily notification (0–59) |

**TypeConverters required** (registered on `@Database`):
- `LocalDate` ↔ `String`: `LocalDate.toString()` / `LocalDate.parse()`
- `ReminderInterval` ↔ `String`: `ReminderInterval.name` / `ReminderInterval.valueOf()`

---

### ReminderInterval (enum)

| Value | Days | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `DAILY` | 1 | Every day |
| `WEEKLY` | 7 | Every 7 days |
| `TWO_WEEKS` | 14 | Default per spec |
| `MONTHLY` | 30 | Exactly 30 days (not calendar month) |

---

## Computed Values (not stored — derived by member functions on `LensCycle`)

| Value | Formula | Notes |
|-------|---------|-------|
| `nextChangeDate` | `startDate + interval.days` | The date the user must change lenses |
| `daysRemaining` | `nextChangeDate - today` (signed) | Negative = overdue |
| `isOverdue` | `daysRemaining < 0` | Drives red progress bar |
| `progressFraction` | `(interval.days - daysRemaining) / interval.days` | 0.0 at start, 1.0 at due date, >1.0 if overdue |

---

## Validation Rules

| Field | Rule | Error |
|-------|------|-------|
| `startDate` | Must not be in the future | "Start date cannot be in the future" |
| `reminderHour` | `0 ≤ hour ≤ 23` | Not user-facing; enforced by time picker |
| `reminderMinute` | `0 ≤ minute ≤ 59` | Not user-facing; enforced by time picker |

---

## State Transitions

```
[No record in DB]
       │
       │ User selects start date + interval → save()
       ▼
[Active cycle]  ─────────────────────────────────────────┐
       │                                                   │
       │ daysRemaining < 0                                 │ User taps "Mark as Changed"
       ▼                                                   │ (confirmation dialog)
[Overdue] (same record, same fields — just display state) │
       │                                                   │
       └──────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                          reset(): startDate = today
```

---

## Database Schema

```kotlin
@Database(
    entities = [LensCycle::class],
    version = 1,
    autoMigrations = []  // add entries when version increments
)
@TypeConverters(DateTypeConverter::class)
abstract class LensTrackerDatabase : RoomDatabase() {
    abstract fun lensCycleDao(): LensCycleDao
}
```

Database name: `"lens_tracker.db"`

---

## Notes

- There is always at most one `LensCycle` row (id=1). Use `INSERT OR REPLACE` semantics via `@Upsert`.
- `nextChangeDate` is intentionally not stored to avoid staleness; it is always re-derived.
- `reminderTime` is stored as hour+minute integers rather than a serialized time object to keep the schema simple and avoid any `kotlinx-datetime` serialization edge cases in Room TypeConverters.
